title: acceptWard
description: Formal spec §7.9. Appends `ward` to `wards`, recording consent to be a guardian or successor of that ward (REQ-7-24).

ward.description: REQ-7-22/REQ-7-23: the ward being accepted. Its DID MUST NOT already be in `wards`.

proof.description: REQ-7-6: one current key, or guardians per `recovery`.
